title: Letterhead and template
subtitle: How every document of your business prints: letterhead, address window, footer. Each change is saved at once and shown in the preview.
loadError: The template could not be loaded.
readOnly: Only the management changes the template.
saveError: The change could not be saved.

header.title: Letterhead
header.layoutHint: The sender details sit on the other side; centred, they sit below the logo.
header.logoSizeHint: At most 30, 40 or 50 mm wide and 20 mm high.
header.addressWindowHint: The side of the window on your C5/C4 envelopes. The positions are Swiss Post's; check them with a test print.

footer.title: Footer
footer.explanation: Up to four columns. Their content comes from the business's master data and is read when printing – never retyped. A column without data is left out.
footer.companyFixed: Always printed: the legal entity at its registered seat

options.title: Options
options.draftWatermarkHint: Across every page of a document that is still a draft, in the document's language.

location.title: A location's letterhead
location.pick: Choose a location in the preview to see its letterhead.
location.explanation: A location replaces only the address block and the logo. The footer always names the legal entity.
location.addressBlockNone: No address block of its own – the business's address is printed.
location.logoNone: No logo of its own – the business's logo is printed.
location.failed: The logo could not be saved.

preview.title: Preview
preview.error: The preview could not be created.
preview.note: A sample document with your business's real data, marked «SAMPLE» across the page.
preview.notAllowed: The preview shows the business's bank details and is available to the management only.
